title: Neural network quantum states in the grand canonical ensemble
summary: Variational Monte Carlo calculations have recently reached state-of-the-art accuracy in the approximation of ground state properties of quantum many-body systems. Making use of flexible neural quantum states and automatic differentiation has bypassed traditional computational obstacles such as reliance on basis sets. In this paper, we propose a neural quantum state architecture capable of representing symmetric bosonic wavefunctions in Fock space, enabling the study of systems with variable particle number.
